912bde66f6d2fc1d.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Marketing & Omnichannel Enabler - Multiple Sclerosis for the Middle East is responsible for shaping and executing customer- and patient-centric commercial strategies, including marketing, brand, and customer engagement, for the assigned disease area across the Middle East. This role connects brand ambition with customer experience - integrating market insights, omnichannel engagement, and product strategies to deliver impactful, insights-driven, and patient-centered outcomes. This role operates 80% for the ME countries, working closely with Disease Area Squads, ME affiliate POCs, Disease Commercialization Leader (DCL), Patient Journey Partners (PJPs), Medical, Access, and Informatics to co-create meaningful experiences and drive commercial success. The remaining 20% will stay within the local Affiliate or Chapter to maintain flexibility and relevance at the local level. Your Responsibilities Marketing Strategy, business planning, and launch readiness Partner closely with DCL and respective Disease Area Squad to implement global brand and portfolio strategies(DACS & CORP), ensuring alignment with business outcomes and patient needs Conduct market analysis and competitive landscaping to inform brand positioning and market opportunities. Lead execution of global segmentation, targeting, and positioning strategies, crafting compelling value propositions for healthcare solutions. Work closely with DCL and ME affiliates to support launch readiness planning, tactical execution, and performance tracking for Malignant Hematology and relevant initiatives. Lead the localization and execution of global communication strategies for campaigns, events, and content assets, ensuring scientific accuracy and market relevance. Shape and contribute to across-affiliate DA financial ambition, ensuring optimal investment planning in collaboration with affiliate teams, finance & DCL. Customer Experience & Omnichannel Engagement Design and execute disease area specific promotional plans and integrated customer experiences by leveraging customer segmentation, persona development, and personalized targeting in collaboration with PJPs and customer facing teams. Identification and management of compelling and modular content needs (promotional & non promotional) that is tailored for different audiences, channels, and formats in close collaboration with internal and external partners, adhering to brand guidelines, compliance/regulatory requirements, and MLR processes. Ensure omnichannel initiatives are designed and driven by identified and relevant cross-country needs, delivering seamless integration between scientific engagement and marketing campaigns. Identify and work regularly with appropriate internal and external resources (e.g., contracting with agencies and vendors). Insights-Driven Planning In close collaboration with local points of contact, affiliate finance partners, and ME analytics/insights enablers, identify market opportunities and gaps by synthesizing insights from multiple functions and sources, including Medical, Access, and Informatics, as well as market research, competitive intelligence, and customer analytics. Based on core & common KPI framework, partner closely with ME and local analytics/insights enablers to integrate brand performance metrics, success signals, and feedback loops so that they inform and enhance portfolio strategy, access initiatives, and omnichannel optimization. Cross-Functional Collaboration, agile ways of working, and training Closely collaborate with ME CX&I network, Medical, Access, Informatics, and PJPs to ensure integrated planning and coordinated execution. Work closely with DCL to identify cross-country pain points and relevant cross-country activities to ensure strong local rollout of regional commercial initiatives and events. Actively participate in squad ceremonies, contributing subject matter expertise in marketing and omnichannel engagement. Share best practices and learnings across the Middle East network Work in alignment with agile principles iterating quickly, adapting to change, and delivering incremental value. Design and execute internal training, onboarding for pre-launch, newcomers, and refreshers on new strategies and tools ensuring competitive readiness. Desired Candidate Profile You hold a Bachelor s degree in life sciences, marketing, business, or a related field. You bring a minimum of 5 years experience in marketing, customer engagement, or commercial roles within the pharmaceutical or healthcare sector. You have proven experience in omnichannel engagement, which is highly preferred. You preferable have prior experience in the designated Disease area You show a strong track record of success in brand planning, launch execution, and omnichannel engagement. You apply strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. You demonstrate an experience in working within cross-functional, matrixed environments. You have experience in working beyond affiliate level while leading or being part of WPTs. You think strategically and creatively. You operate with a strong customer- and patient-centric mindset. You leverage data and digital marketing fluency to drive impact. You adapt quickly and embrace a growth mindset. You communicate with clarity and persuasion.

Job Responsibilities: Provide weekly one-on-one coaching sessions to beneficiaries remotely. Assess the professional status of beneficiaries and help them set goals and develop practical plans to achieve them. Guide beneficiaries in improving their resumes and LinkedIn profiles. Train beneficiaries on job search strategies and identifying suitable companies and opportunities. Develop professional communication and networking skills. Prepare beneficiaries for job interviews and conduct mock interviews. Provide guidance on salary negotiation, promotions, and career transitions. Monitor the progress of beneficiaries and provide practical feedback and recommendations to help them execute their plans. Document sessions and follow-up notes, and coordinate with the Customer Success and Operations team. Commit to session schedules and the quality standards adopted in the program. Qualifications and Requirements: Saudi nationality is required. Practical experience in Human Resources, Recruitment and Talent Acquisition, or Career Consulting and Development. Strong knowledge of the Saudi labor market and hiring requirements and career paths. Ability to provide professional individual consulting and coaching sessions. Familiarity with strategies for improving resumes and professional presence on LinkedIn. Skills in job interview preparation, career guidance, and effective communication. Ability to work with beneficiaries from different sectors and professional levels. High skills in listening, analysis, and providing constructive feedback. Proven experience within well-known restaurant brands or established F&B retail businesses. Strong experience managing multiple departments, particularly Operations, R&D, Maintenance, Projects, and Call Center functions. The Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO will contribute to building resilience and ensuring the execution of daily deliverables by navigating regulatory landscapes and supporting the organization's overall compliance framework. The role focuses on delivering straightforward and scalable solutions within the financial services industry. Key Responsibilities Manage the assessment of Compliance and Financial Crimes risks. Execute and deliver the regulatory compliance oversight programme for SSSAFS, ensuring adherence to Capital Market Authority (CMA) rules. Develop and maintain relationships with SSSAFS business units, providing advisory support for regulatory queries and ensuring timely resolution of Compliance issues. Consult, advise, and support management on compliance and regulatory matters impacting business decisions and duties. Act as the Compliance and Financial Crimes representative in governance committees and forums. Produce written reports for Senior Management on Compliance risk opinions and the delivery of Compliance and Financial Crimes programmes for SSSAFS, highlighting progress and significant matters. 91305dd53c396b66.description: About the Role Alesayi Holding is seeking a Fleet Supervisor to manage regional fleet operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Fleet Supervisor ensures reliable and efficient transportation services by managing fleet costs, vehicle utilization, maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, and driver workforce management. Key Responsibilities Manage the regional fleet budget, including fuel, maintenance, leasing/ownership, drivers, and fines. Monitor cost per kilometre and cost per vehicle against budget, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions. Review and approve supplier invoices and statements of account for fuel, maintenance, leasing, insurance, and spare parts. Reconcile charges against vehicle records, investigate discrepancies, and dispute unjustified costs. Develop and review regional route plans, consolidate trips, and optimize fleet size based on operational demand. Utilize GPS tracking and fleet data to minimize idle vehicles, unnecessary mileage, and unauthorized vehicle use. Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed and that vehicle inspections, registration, insurance, permits, and roadworthiness requirements remain valid. Monitor vehicle availability and minimize downtime. Enforce driver operating procedures and road-safety standards. Review and investigate incidents, ensure compliance with driving licence requirements, rest hours, and vehicle checks, and follow up on corrective actions. Coordinate transportation requirements for new project mobilization, project demobilisation, and changes in workforce demand to ensure sufficient vehicles and drivers are available on time. Demonstrated ability to manage regional fleet operations, including cost control, maintenance, and safety. Experience with driver workforce management and operational reporting. 91a816e99893e98e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة درة البتيل لخدمات السفر والسياحة عن كاتب تذاكر سفر للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمات السفر المتكاملة للعملاء، بما في ذلك حجوزات الطيران والفنادق وتنظيم الرحلات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسويق وبيع وتنظيم عروض تذاكر السفر والرحلات لمختلف وسائل النقل. ترتيب حجوزات السفر والرحلات البرية أو الجوية أو البحرية نيابة عن العملاء، بالتنسيق مع وكالات السفر ومنظمي الرحلات. الرد على استفسارات العملاء المتعلقة بحجوزات التذاكر والجولات السياحية ووسائل النقل والوجهات المطلوبة. إدارة العلاقات مع الموردين والعملاء الرئيسيين والحفاظ عليها، وتنفيذ حلول فعالة، وتقديم خدمة بمعايير عالية. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ أنشطة حجز تذاكر الطيران والفنادق وتنظيم الرحلات وإصدار التأشيرات والرخص الدولية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة درة البتيل لخدمات السفر والسياحة في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. يركز العمل على تقديم خدمات سفر عالية الجودة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

91c63398cc9667f1.description: About the Role Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, is seeking a Field Service Representative for its Energy Services group. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Al Qassim, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Field Service Representative will be primarily responsible for providing contractual services and offering problem-solving support to customers regarding their products, applications, and solutions. Key Responsibilities Solve complex, multi-disciplinary problems. Lead in maintaining and distributing troubleshooting guides and bulletins to relevant departments. Prepare reports detailing problems and solutions to initiate corrective product modifications or recommend process changes. Conduct site surveys and product/application audits. Manage inventory of chemical delivery systems. Collect samples for chemical program monitoring. Deliver chemicals to customers as needed. Conduct field evaluations of new products and lead pre-trial surveys for site visits. Interact with internal and external customers and resources. Maintain accurate records based on information gathered during trials and surveys. Create troubleshooting service guides and bulletins for existing products. Coordinate and manage sampling and inventory schedules. Coordinate the implementation of solutions with customers. Assist sales in preparing business proposals. 91dac73bfa9f20d4.description: About ExeQut ExeQut is a rapidly expanding consulting and technology services firm. The company specializes in cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud solutions, AI-driven platforms, and custom software engineering. ExeQut partners with organizations in both the public and private sectors to deliver significant digital transformation initiatives across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Role of Penetration Tester ExeQut is seeking a Penetration Tester to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves identifying, exploiting, and reporting on security vulnerabilities across various technical environments. The primary objective is to help clients understand and mitigate their real-world security risks. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct penetration testing across web, API, mobile, network, infrastructure, cloud, and Active Directory environments. Identify and safely exploit vulnerabilities, then assess their business impact. Perform vulnerability validation, privilege escalation, and comprehensive security assessments. Utilize security tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Kali Linux, and BloodHound. Prepare detailed technical reports that include findings, risk ratings, evidence, and remediation recommendations. Perform remediation retesting and communicate findings effectively to technical teams. Required Experience and Skills 3-6 years of experience in penetration testing. Proficiency in identifying and exploiting security vulnerabilities across diverse platforms. Experience with industry-standard penetration testing tools. Ability to prepare clear and comprehensive technical reports. Compensation and Benefits This position offers a performance-based compensation structure. Employees also receive Bupa medical insurance at the Golden Tier. ExeQut provides ongoing training and mentorship from experienced leadership, along with exposure to high-impact projects with leading clients in Saudi Arabia. The company fosters a collaborative and growth-oriented culture. Application ExeQut invites applications from hands-on penetration testers who are focused on uncovering and resolving security risks for clients.

Key Responsibilities Conduct in-service inspections of plant equipment and piping in refinery and petrochemical facilities. Perform inspections using appropriate tools and techniques. Review inspection findings to identify potential defects, deterioration, or integrity concerns. Prepare accurate inspection reports and technical documentation. Provide technical recommendations based on inspection findings. Ensure all inspection activities comply with applicable API standards and project requirements. Support equipment integrity and reliability through effective inspection and reporting. Maintain proper inspection records and documentation. Qualifications and Experience An Engineering Degree or Diploma in Mechanical or Metallurgical Engineering is required. A minimum of 8 years of experience in refinery or petrochemical plant in-service inspection is mandatory. Candidates must hold at least two valid API certifications from the following: API 510 – Pressure Vessel Inspector API 570 – Piping Inspector API 653 – Aboveground Storage Tank Inspector Familiarity with API 598, API 572, API 576, and other relevant inspection standards. Hands-on experience in equipment and piping inspection. Experience with inspection tools, technical reporting, and preparing inspection recommendations. Work Type This is a contract position. Salary details will be disclosed during the application process.

9139b9ca8f351db8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالرحمن عبدالله حمزه الشريف الامنية عن اخصائي دعم فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان سير العمليات التقنية بسلاسة ودعم المستخدمين في بيئة عمل بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع المواصفات الفنية للأجهزة الجديدة، واستلامها والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة. توثيق جميع الأجهزة وملحقاتها داخل المؤسسة، وتسجيل المشاكل التقنية اليومية التي تطرأ عليها. إجراء الصيانة الدورية والوقائية اللازمة للأجهزة لضمان كفاءتها واستمراريتها. الاستجابة لاستفسارات المستخدمين المتعلقة بالمشاكل التقنية، وتقديم الحلول الممكنة أو توجيههم إلى الأقسام المختصة. التحقق من حالة الأنظمة والتأكد من احتوائها على البرامج الأساسية مثل نظم التشغيل، وتحويل الأعطال الكبيرة إلى الموردين أو مسؤولي الصيانة. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية وتطوير أساليب العمل باستخدام أحدث التقنيات المتاحة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحديد المواصفات الفنية للأجهزة والتحقق من مطابقتها. معرفة قوية بإجراءات الصيانة الدورية والوقائية للأجهزة. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات التقنية وتقديم الدعم للمستخدمين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية وتوثيق المعلومات بدقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة عبدالرحمن عبدالله حمزه الشريف الامنية. ستتاح الفرصة للموظف لتطوير مهاراته في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على استخدام التقنيات الحديثة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

915c0db46a88e6ca.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Planning Engineer to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience and involves developing, monitoring, and reporting on project schedules and progress for EPC projects. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update detailed EPC project schedules using Primavera P6. Prepare and manage baseline schedules, recovery schedules, and look-ahead plans. Monitor project progress against approved schedules and highlight deviations. Perform critical path analysis and recommend corrective actions to mitigate delays. Forecast project completion dates and support project management in schedule decision-making. Progress Monitoring and Reporting Monitor engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for management and client submissions. Develop project dashboards, progress measurement systems, S-curves, and resource histograms. Track productivity, resource utilization, and key project performance indicators (KPIs). Maintain project planning records and reporting documentation. Procurement and Manufacturing Coordination Monitor material procurement, manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and site delivery milestones. Forecast material requirements and coordinate manufacturing clearances in line with project schedules. Track vendor and subcontractor deliverables against contractual milestones. Support timely mobilization of suppliers and subcontractors. Project Controls and Commercial Support Prepare cost summaries and mobilization estimates based on received quotations. Develop techno-commercial reports to monitor project financial performance and overall project health. Assist in cash flow forecasting, cost-to-complete monitoring, and project performance analysis. Support change management, delay analysis, and Extension of Time (EOT) evaluations when required. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, QA/QC, HSE, and commercial teams for schedule updates. Participate in progress review meetings with SEC, National Grid, subcontractors, and project stakeholders. Support project management in identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

91d1ea3d97127f97.description: About Ecolab and the Role Ecolab's Global Supply Chain comprises over 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers, and facilities designed to support direct sales, marketing, and distribution. This network drives company growth by achieving operational efficiencies and high service levels, creating a competitive advantage. We are seeking a TPM Leader to join our team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) program across the plant, aiming for sustainable improvements in equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and employee engagement. Role Purpose and Contribution The TPM Leader will lead key TPM pillars and build a long-term TPM culture within the plant. This position supports cross-functional teams and ensures the plant progresses toward world-class manufacturing standards. The core purpose is to lead and coordinate the plant TPM program in alignment with site strategy/OGSM and the regional/global TPM program, proactively driving a continuous improvement culture to achieve the site vision. Key Responsibilities Ensure TPM implementation aligns with the site master plan and regional/global TPM strategy. Serve as the subject matter expert for the Plant Manager and leadership team on TPM governance and deployment. Coach and train all site associates in effective application of TPM tools and techniques to achieve site KPIs. Contribute to the regional TPM community by developing and sharing best practices. Develop and promote a loss-driven culture through appropriate TPM tools and techniques. Identify and prioritize continuous improvement areas via audits, benchmarking, and gap analysis. Support SHE improvements via the SHE Pillar, ensuring alignment with the site master plan. Utilize loss analysis across the plant to identify opportunities and prioritize actions. Lead by example, spending time on the floor for observations, audits, identifying gaps/defects, and timely actions. Co-create, coordinate, and organize the plant's TPM steering committee, pillars, and teams for consistent deployment and results. Ensure TPM philosophy, processes, and procedures are embedded into the site's culture. Monitor and report progress against site KPIs to implement improvement programs. Lead T&PD & 5S pillars; design and implement a competency management system for the plant. Develop and train associates in fundamental TPM tools including 5S, Kaizens, OPLs, SOPs, CIL, and checklists. Create and maintain the TPM master plan, incorporating benchmarking with other sites. Lead the plant towards gold certifications according to the agreed timeline and plant master plan/strategy. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience: 3+ years in the TPM field within a manufacturing plant. Operational Knowledge: Working knowledge across Operations in a dynamic environment. Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook). Language: Fluency in English (spoken, written, and reading), with excellent communication skills. Analytical Skills: Analytical thinking, capable of making data-driven and informed decisions. Professional Attributes Results Orientation: Consistently delivers tasks on time and with targeted quality, prioritizing work based on value to the department. Business Acumen: Recognizes key business drivers (*, KPIs, metrics, OGSM) and their link to work plans, demonstrating understanding of Supply Chain work processes. Decision Quality: Considers multiple aspects of decisions, develops detailed alternatives, and makes timely, accurate, and effective decisions. Career Development This role offers a long-term career path with exposure to various areas of Ecolab’s supply chain. The successful candidate will have access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology within a company that values sustainability, promotes a safety-focused culture, and has been recognized for its ethical standards.

911ae2319c539ea6.description: About the Role Airbus Helicopters Arabia for Aircraft Maintenance is seeking a Key Logistics Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This contract position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves managing various logistics activities to ensure operational performance and compliance. Key Responsibilities Manage physical logistics activities, including performance and improvement control, KPI implementation, and adherence to Airbus Logistics solutions and policies. Drive issue resolution through established alert and escalation processes. 91590830ebe799d4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية في المدينة المنورة عن معلم ثانوي لغة أجنبية للانضمام إلى فريقها. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الثانوية في مجال اللغة الأجنبية، ووضع خطط الدروس، وتقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية، ودعم التنمية الشاملة للطلاب. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس وطرق التدريس الأخرى. تدريس الطلاب في مجال اللغة الأجنبية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وإعطاء الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الفصل الدراسي لضمان بيئة تعليمية إيجابية. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم التقدم المحرز لدى الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك الأكاديمي. تحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم التعليمية. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تدريس اللغة الأجنبية. القدرة على وضع خطط دروس فعالة وتصميم مواد تعليمية جذابة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة مدرسية داعمة في المدينة المنورة، ويكون جزءًا من فريق تعليمي ملتزم بتوفير تعليم عالي الجودة لطلاب المرحلة الثانوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة التعليمية في مدارس الوطن النموذجية الأهلية.

9199e4d45c97cf35.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب حسن جميل حسن بن صالح للخدمات العقارية عن وسيط عقاري للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مساعدة البائعين في ترويج عقاراتهم، والتوسط في التعاملات بين البائعين والمشترين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عقود الإيجار وتحصيلها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال العقاري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة البائعين وتقديم اقتراحات حول أفضل طرق ترويج العقارات لجذب العروض. الإعلان عن العقارات والتوسط في التعاملات بين البائعين والمشترين. تأجير العقارات وعمل عقود الإيجار عبر منصة إيجار وتحصيل الإيجارات. تقييم رغبات العملاء والميزانيات المحددة والقدرات الاقتصادية وتقديم الاقتراحات المناسبة. استكمال الوثائق والمستندات القانونية لإجراء التعاقدات والاتفاقيات، والإشراف على إدارة التوكيلات العقارية. تقييم قيمة العقارات من خلال إجراء بحث شامل في السوق. التعاون والتواصل مع العملاء والمقاولين والمحامين وأصحاب العقارات. تقديم معلومات بشأن القواعد القانونية والأسعار والمواصفات وتوافر الممتلكات. بناء العلاقات وتقديم دعم متميز للعملاء بعد البيع لضمان رضاهم، وبناء شبكة علاقات قوية لجلب عملاء جدد. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الوساطة العقارية. القدرة على تقييم رغبات العملاء وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. معرفة جيدة بالوثائق القانونية والعقود المتعلقة بالعقارات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع مختلف الأطراف. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مكتب حسن جميل حسن بن صالح للخدمات العقارية. يركز المكتب على تقديم خدمات عقارية احترافية لعملائه. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقًا. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

91082ed4ec7e41c7.description: الترويج للمنتجات والخدمات : تقديم معلومات شاملة عن المنتجات أو الخدمات المتاحة للعملاء وإبراز مميزاتها وفوائدها. تحقيق الأهداف البيعية : العمل على تحقيق أو تجاوز الأهداف الشهرية والسنوية المحددة للمبيعات. بناء العلاقات مع العملاء : إنشاء شبكة قوية من العملاء الجدد والحفاظ على العلاقات مع العملاء الحاليين لضمان استمرارية التعامل. فهم احتياجات العملاء : الاستماع إلى متطلبات العملاء وتقديم الحلول الأنسب لتلبية توقعاتهم. إدارة العمليات البيعية : توثيق جميع العمليات البيعية، وإعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالأداء والمبيعات الشهرية. متابعة السوق والمنافسين : تحليل السوق والاتجاهات البيعية ومراقبة أداء المنافسين لتحديد الفرص والتحديات. حل المشكلات : التعامل مع استفسارات العملاء وشكاواهم بفعالية لضمان رضاهم وتحسين تجربة الشراء. التعاون مع الفرق الأخرى : العمل مع فرق التسويق والإدارة لضمان تنفيذ استراتيجيات البيع بنجاح.

91a4efa0c9208b99.description: About the Role: We are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Head of Learning to lead the development and delivery of Qiddiya’s learning architecture, ensuring learning enables performance today and builds the capabilities required for future growth. Reporting to the Executive Director – Talent Management, the role will partner closely with business and HR leaders to align learning with operational priorities, close critical skill gaps, and embed continuous development. Combining strategic focus, strong knowledge of the Saudi learning environment, and hands-on execution, it will build internal capability, shape impactful learning experiences, and position Qiddiya at the forefront of learning and performance. Key Responsibilities: Learning Architecture & Pathways · Design and implement Qiddiya’s learning architecture, including frameworks, pathways, curricula, standards, and development journeys across priority capability areas. · Translate strategic priorities into practical learning roadmaps and interventions that support current performance and future workforce readiness. · Ensure learning pathways are relevant to Qiddiya’s functions, assets, and subsidiaries, and linked to measurable improvements in capability, performance, and business outcomes. Learning Governance, Policy & Standards · Establish and continuously improve learning governance, policies, standards, operating procedures, and decision rights across Qiddiya. · Ensure learning practices align with Saudi regulatory requirements, internal policies, enterprise risk expectations, and quality standards. · Define reporting and effectiveness measures to track adoption, application, capability growth, stakeholder value, and return on learning investment. Digital & In-Person Learning Ecosystem · Lead the growth, adoption, and integration of Qiddiya’s learning ecosystem, including SuccessFactors, Sana, and future digital learning solutions. · Create blended learning experiences that combines digital, in-person, social, experiential, and performance-based learning. · Partner with internal stakeholders, providers, academic institutions, and professional bodies to improve access, personalization, learner experience, and insight through technology and data. Leadership of the Learning Organization · Design and lead the future learning organization, including learning business partnership, digital learning, operations, design, and enabling capabilities. · Build a resilient, service-oriented, commercially aware learning team that partners effectively with the business and delivers with pace and quality. Key Requirements: Experience: · Minimum of 15 years of experience in Learning & Development, with at least 8 years in a leadership or managerial role · Proven success designing and delivering enterprise learning in complex, fast-paced environments, ideally with regional or global scope including the Middle East · Strong understanding of the Saudi learning environment, including relevant regulatory, governance, workforce development, and compliance expectations. · Strong experience managing internal stakeholders, external providers, budgets, business cases, and learning investment decisions. · Digitally fluent, with a strong understanding of learning technologies, experience working with SuccessFactors and Sana preferred · Experience building internal capability and managing external partnerships · Demonstrated use of learning analytics and data to improve outcomes and show impact Educational Qualifications: · Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Psychology, Business Administration or related field. · Master’s degree (e.g. Organization Psychology, Organization Behavior) or relevant advanced HR certifications (e.g. CIPD, ATD, SHRM) preferred. Skills & Competencies: · Deep understanding of learning science, adult development principles, and performance-based learning approaches · Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and a clear link between learning and business goals · Proven ability to communicate, engage and influence all levels of the organization including senior leaders, driving buy-in and fostering a culture of ownership. · Thrives in a fast-moving, rapidly evolving environment, continuously improving processes · Ability to work independently, lead multiple projects, and drive initiatives to deadline in a fast-paced environment. · Skilled at balancing strategy and delivery, with a hands-on approach when needed · Brings external perspective and a forward-looking, market-aware mindset · Embodies Qiddiya’s culture of Play and high performance Why Join Us? · Build a Real Legacy….an Actual City: Imagine being part of a team that's not just shaping an organization, but helping to build a unique city from the ground up. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to contribute to a landmark project that will pioneer the future of 'Play'. · Shape the Future of Learning in Saudi Arabia: Bring together Saudi context, global learning practices, digital innovation, and enterprise capability building to create something distinctive and enduring.

91b4f09fa164640a.description: Job Overview We are seeking a high-caliber Senior System Analyst to join our team in Riyadh. You will bridge business stakeholders, project leadership, architects, and delivery teams for a large-scale digital integration program. You will translate business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear functional and technical requirements across integration services, event streaming, the developer portal, reporting, and operations. You will also coordinate interface requirements with the AI engineering workstream, while AI model design, development, and training remain outside this role. The ideal candidate is a native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency and strong command of the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Key Responsibilities Requirements Engineering: Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyze, validate, and trace functional and non-functional requirements for the non-AI project scope. System Analysis & Documentation: Produce BRDs, SRS, functional and technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface requirements, data mappings, and analysis documents for integration services and event topics. Process & Integration Modelling: Document current- and future-state processes, gap analyses, workflows, sequence diagrams, system interactions, APIs, integration mappings, and data flows. Requirements Lifecycle & Governance: Maintain traceability, backlog readiness, change requests, priorities, dependencies, and alignment with security, data, service-level, and technical governance requirements. Validation & Acceptance Support: Define acceptance criteria and test scenarios; collaborate with QA on integration, performance, and UAT activities; and verify delivered services against approved requirements. Cross-Functional Delivery & AI Coordination: Work with integration, portal, event-streaming, operations, cybersecurity, data-governance, and AI teams; define AI-related interfaces and data requirements without owning AI model design, development, or training; and support handover and knowledge transfer. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis or Business Systems Analysis, including enterprise integration or digital transformation projects. Process & Tool Proficiency: Strong expertise in requirements engineering, stakeholder facilitation, functional and non-functional analysis, traceability, and change management. Hands-on experience with requirements, backlog, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and MS Visio (or similar). Deep understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery, including documentation, testing, UAT, and release-readiness activities. Data & Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of APIs, web services, system interfaces, data mapping, integration patterns, and event-driven systems. Practical knowledge of databases, SQL, JSON, XML, interface specifications, and secure system-integration concepts. Preferred exposure to IBM App Connect, API Connect, DataPower, MQ, Kafka/Confluent, developer portals, Instana, or Kibana. Communication & Domain Knowledge: Native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency (written and spoken). Ability to explain complex system behaviour, dependencies, and technical requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with KSA digital transformation, cybersecurity, data-governance, and regulatory environments is a strong plus. Professional Attributes: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate complex requirements, identify gaps, and support viable system solutions. Proven ability to work across business, architecture, development, QA, operations, security, data, and AI workstreams. High attention to detail, clear ownership of requirements, and commitment to meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

9143bbf0f50ffaed.description: Our client, a successful restaurant group in Dubai, is looking for a skilled Commis II – Butcher to support the preparation, portioning, and handling of meat and poultry products while maintaining the highest standards of quality, hygiene, and food safety. The ideal candidate should have solid butchery experience, good knife skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment. As a valued member of the kitchen team, the Commis II – Butcher will work closely with the Executive Chef , Sous Chef , and Chef de Partie to ensure the timely preparation and availability of meat products while maintaining kitchen efficiency and compliance with food safety standards. Primary Responsibilities Assist in the preparation, trimming, cutting, deboning, and portioning of meat and poultry according to company standards. Inspect meat deliveries to ensure quality, freshness, and compliance with specifications. Prepare meat products following recipes, portion control, and presentation standards. Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of meat products. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and sanitation of the butcher section and workstations. Operate butcher equipment and tools safely and efficiently. Monitor stock levels and assist with inventory control and proper storage. Follow all food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards. Assist in training and guiding junior kitchen staff when required. Perform other duties assigned by the Executive Chef, Sous Chef, or Chef de Partie. 2–3 years of experience as a Commis Chef or Butcher , with at least 1 year of experience in a professional butcher section. Experience in a high-volume restaurant, hotel, or catering operation is an advantage. Culinary diploma or equivalent professional training. Good knowledge of meat cuts, portioning, trimming, deboning, and proper storage techniques. Ability to read, write, and communicate in English. Strong knife skills and attention to detail. Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good organizational and time-management skills. Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to learn. Able to work indoors in chilled and refrigerated environments. Able to stand and walk for extended periods during shifts. Physically capable of lifting meat products and operating butcher equipment safely. Willing to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays, on a rotational basis. As per the company package
